en.title: The Void on the Coastline
en.premise: An elderly man suffering from dementia, unable to communicate clearly, stands accused of arson at a local welfare facility. A young court-appointed lawyer discovers a minute logical contradiction between the man's fragmented utterances and the "perfect testimony" presented by the prosecution. This discrepancy leads to a dark social truth: an illegal dumping scandal that the town has kept hidden for decades. This is a story that explores how one can prove the "memories of the vulnerable"—memories long ignored by society—within the cold, unyielding halls of justice.

zh.title: 海岸线的空白
zh.premise: 一名患有认知障碍、难以进行有效沟通的老人，因涉嫌纵火焚烧当地福利设施而被起诉。年轻的国选辩护人在老人的断续言行与检方提出的“完美证言”之间，发现了一丝逻辑上的矛盾。而这一矛盾，竟指向了该城镇数十年来一直隐瞒的非法倾倒事件这一社会黑暗面。这是一个关于如何在冰冷的法庭之上，去证明那些被世人遗忘的“弱者记忆”的故事。
